questions.question:
The given bar graph represents the number of students admitted in four schools (S1, S2, S3, S4) during two consecutive years 2017 and 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dc593c64bf13c9f43c6fd3a964bd6670ab157f07bb4a0bd917b6b319d767425.png] 

The total number of students admitted in school S3 for both years is approximately what percent of total student admitted in school S2 for both years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of students admitted in school S3 for both years are = 200 and 150 

Number of students admitted in school S2 for both years are = 240 and 360

**Formula:**

x as a percentage of y = (x/y) × 100

**Calculation:**

Total number of students admitted in school S3 for both years are = 200 + 150 = 350

Total number of students admitted in school S2 for both years are = 240 + 360 = 600

∴ Required percentage = (350/600) × 100 = 58.33%

questions.question: Six years ago, the average of the ages of Ravi, Mohan and Govind was 32 years. If Shyam joins them now, the average of the ages of all four of them is 36 years. The present age of Shyam is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Six years ago, the average of the ages of Ravi, Mohan and Govind = 32 years

If Shyam joins them now, the average of the ages of all four of them = 36 years

**Formula:**

Average = Sum of all observations/Total number of all observations

**Calculation:**

Six years ago, the sum of the ages of Rav, Mohan and Govind = 32 × 3 = 96 years

Present sum of the ages of Ravi, Mohan and Govind = 96 + 18 = 114 years

Sum of ages of Shyam, Ravi, Mohan and Govind = 36 × 4 = 144 years

∴ Present age of Shyam = 144 - 114 = 30 years

questions.question: The length and breadth of a cuboid are increased by 10% and 20%, respectively, and its height is decreased by 20%. The percentage increase in the volume of the cuboid is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The length of a cuboid is increased = 10%

The breadth of a cuboid is increased = 20%

The height of a cuboid decreased = 20%

**Formula:**

Volume of cuboid = lbh

**Calculation:**

Let the length, breadth and height of cuboid be 10 unit

Volume of cuboid = 10 × 10 × 10 = 1000 

New length of cuboid = 10 × (110/100) = 11

New breadth of cuboid = 10 × (120/100) = 12 

New height of cuboid = 10 × (80/100) = 8

Volume of cuboid = 11 × 12 × 8 = 1056

Volume increase = 1056 - 1000 = 56 

∴ Volume increased by (in %) = (56/1000) × 100 = 28/5 = 5 dfrac{3}{5} \%

∠A = ∠B = ∠C = 60°.

questions.question: If x ∶ y = 3 ∶ 2 and x + y = 90. Then the value 7(x - y) ∶ (x + y) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x : y = 3 : 2 

x + y = 90

**Formula:**

If N is divided into a : b, then

First part = N × a/(a + b)

Second part = N × b/(a + b)

**Calculation:**

x : y = 3a : 2a

According to the question

3a + 2a = 90

⇒ 5a = 90

⇒ a = 90/5

⇒ a = 18

x = 3 × 18 = 54

y = 2 × 18 = 36

Now,

7(x - y) ∶ (x + y) 

⇒ 7 (54 - 36) : (54 + 36)

⇒ 7 × 18 : 90

⇒ 7 : 5

What percentage is the average admission of schools S3 and S4 in 2018 of the average admission of schools S1 and S2 in 2017?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of students admitted in school S3 in 2018 = 150

Number of students admitted in school S4 in 2018 = 250

Number of students admitted in school S1 in 2017 = 250

Number of students admitted in school S2 in 2017 = 240

**Formula:**

x as a percentage of y = (x/y) × 100 

**Calculation:**

Average admission in school S3 and S4 in 2018 = (150 + 250)/2 = 400/2 = 200

Average admission in school S1 and S2 in 2017 = (250 + 240)/2 = 490/2 = 245

∴ Required percentage = (200/245) × 100 = 81.63%

questions.question: The cost price of 12 pens is equal to the selling price of 8 pens. The profit percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

CP of 12 pens is equal to the SP of 8 pens.

**Formula:**

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

According to the question

12 CP = 8 SP

⇒ CP : SP = 8 : 12

⇒ CP : SP = 2 : 3

Let CP = Rs. 2 and SP = 3

Profit = 3 - 2 = 1

Profit = (1/2) × 100

**∴ Profit % is 50%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

**Concept used:**

If cost article > selling article, then there is profit,

So, profit % = (cost article - selling article)/(selling article) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Profit = (12 - 8)/8 × 100

⇒ Profit = 50%

questions.question: If 2x³ + ax² + bx - 2 leaves the remainders 7 and 0 when divided by (2x - 3) and (x + 2), respectively, then the values of a and b are respectively.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If 2x3 + ax2 + bx - 2 leaves the remainders 7 and 0 when divided by (2x - 3) and (x + 2), respectively.

**Calculation:**

If 2x3 + ax2 + bx - 2 is divided by (2x - 3), remainder = 7

2x - 3 = 0

2x = 3

x = 3/2

Put x = 3/2 in 2x3 + ax2 + bx - 2 = 7

⇒ 2 × (3/2)3 + a × (3/2)2 + b × (3/2) - 2 = 7

⇒ 2 × (27/8) + a × (9/4) + 3b/2 = 7 + 2

⇒ 27/4 + 9a/4 + 3b/2 = 9

⇒ 9a/4 + 3b/2 = 9 - (27/4)

⇒ 9a/4 + 3b/2 = (36 - 27)/4

⇒ (9a + 6b)/4 = 9/4

⇒ 9a + 6b = 9 ----(1)

Similarly, 

If 2x3 + ax2 + bx - 2 is divided by (x + 2), remainder = 0

x + 2 = 0

x = -2

Put x = -2 in 2x3 + ax2 + bx - 2 = 0

⇒ 2 × (-2)3 + a × (-2)2 + b × (-2) - 2 = 0

⇒ 2 × (-8) + a × (4) - 2b - 2 = 0 

⇒ -16 + 4a - 2b - 2 = 0

⇒4a - 2b = 18 ----(2)

Multiply by 3 in equation (2)

⇒ 12a - 6b = 54 ----(3)

Add equation (1) and equation (3)

⇒ 21a = 63

⇒ a = 63/21

∴ a = 3 

Put a = 3 in equation (2)

⇒ 4 × 3 - 2b = 18

⇒ 12 - 2b = 18

⇒ 2b = 12 - 18

⇒ 2b = -6

∴ b = -3

questions.question: Tap A can fill a tank in 20 hours and tap B can fill the same tank in 30 hours. If both taps are opened together, then how much time will be taken to fill the tank?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Tap A can fill a tank in = 20 hrs

Tap B can fill the same tank = 30 hrs

**Calculation:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Total work = 60 unit

Efficiency of A = 3 unit/hrs

Efficiency of B = 2 unit/hrs

Total efficiency of A and B = 2 + 3 = 5 unit/hrs

∴ Time taken by A and B to fill the tank = 60/5 = 12 hrs

questions.question: A boat covered a distance of 15 km upstream in 5 hours and a distance of 42 km downstream in 6 hours. The speed of the stream in km/h is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A boat covered 15 km upstream distance in = 5 hrs

A boat covered 42 km downstream distance in = 6 hrs.

**Formula:**

Speed = distance/time

If speed of boat and stream be x and y km/hr respectively, then

Upstream speed = (x – y) km/hr

Downstream speed = (x + y) km/hr

**Calculation:**

Let speed of boat and stream be x and y km/hr respectively, then

Upstream speed = (x – y) km/hr

Downstream speed = (x + y) km/hr

According to the question

(x + y) = 42/6

⇒ (x + y) = 7 ----(1)

(x - y) = 15/5

⇒ (x - y) = 3 ----(2)

Add equation (1) and equation (2)

⇒ 2x = 10

⇒ x = 5 

From equation (1)

5 + y = 7

⇒ y = 7 - 5

⇒ y = 2

**∴ Speed of stream is 2 km/hr.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

**Concept used:**If the upstream speed is U and the downstream speed is D,

Then, the speed of stream = (D - U)/2

And, the speed of Boat = (D + U)/2

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Downstream speed = 42/6 = 7 km/hr

Upstream speed = 15/5 = 3 km/hr

So, speed of stream is (7 - 3)/2 = 2 km/hr

questions.question: Two tangents AP and AQ are drawn to a circle with centre O from an external point A, where P and Q are points on the circle. If AP = 12 cm and ∠PAQ = 60°, then the length of chord PQ is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AP = 12 cm

∠PAQ = 60°

**Formula:**

The radius from the center of the circle to the point of tangency is perpendicular to the tangent line.

sin A = Perpendicular/Hypotenuse

tan A = Perpendicular/Base

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d564c42e8d36907b7d4ad7e50a8ea5916923b385cf13244eb628480236f4281f.png] 

In OPAQ

∠OPA + ∠OQA + ∠PAQ + ∠POQ = 360°

⇒ 90° + 90° + 60° + ∠POQ = 360° - 240°

⇒ ∠POQ = 120°

⇒ ∠POA = ∠QOA = ∠POQ/2

⇒ ∠POA = 120°/2

⇒ ∠POA = 60°

In ΔOPA

tan 60 = PA/OP

⇒ √3 = 12/OP

⇒ OP = 12/√3

⇒ OP = 4√3

In ΔOPM

sin 60 = PM/OP

⇒ √3/2 = PM/4√3

⇒ PM = (√3/2) 4√3

PM = 6

⇒ PQ = 2PM

⇒ PQ = 2 × 6

⇒ PQ = 12 cm

**∴ The length of chord PQ is 12 cm.**
